title: ICLR rebuttal [R]
summary: I'm about to submit my iclr rebuttal, and I was wondering if it's okay to highlight the changes I've made to my manuscript using a different text color to make them easier for the reviewers to identify. I checked the author guidelines, but couldn't find any information about this
